description: For jobsite safety, this approval form records task hazards, competent-person controls, PPE, access protection, emergency contacts, and weather limits. use_case: Use the approval form during jobsite hazard assessment and control verification when the jobsite safety record must identify work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces. Complete the applicable handoff for competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger.
